subject: Thanks for the quick reply.
author: Edmund
body: Thanks for the quick reply. That would be great, hopefully they'll be interested. I spoke to one of the engineers from the dominator team the other week and he told me he thought Dominator was the hardest in the series to play. I've hardly had time to play it and don't profess to be any good, it would take me forever to get up to the 75% point although I still don't know how many points that is as I've no idea how many Dominator Points there are in the game.

subject: PSP Dominator Screen Cracks
author: ZombieTron
body:
Xandu has played Dominator on the PSP and wrote this about the screen damage on our FAQ:

"I was playing Burnout Dominator on my PSP and suddenly there was a crack in my screen. What is going on?

When you have completed 25% and 75% of the game you unlock "Menu damage". It is worth zero Dominator Points. It has an interesting and purely cosmetic effect on the game menu screens. You get a puncture mark in your screen with cracks going out of it."

But we don't have it on PS2 (don't have a PS to play it on either) although I am sure someone on the site might, I will send a message to someone who might be able to help you out.

It does a little bit of damage at 25% so that shouldn't take too long to get to... and then at 75% the damage increases.

Welcome to BurnoutAholics! 🙂
